purpose: Effect of memoizing native host-context argument validation during stylesheet preparation; comparison is against the previous 45-assertion selector stage.

method.frequency_control: Uncontrolled boost/governor; shared machine. Paired sampling reduces drift, but intervals do not model systematic host interference.
method.compiler: rustc opt-level=2 debuginfo=0, identical frozen native dependencies and support crates on both sides
method.ci_method: 5000 bootstrap resamples of paired percentage changes; deterministic seed 173, median, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; no multiple-comparison adjustment. Diagnostic evidence, not a universal performance claim.
method.combined_metric: all_samples sums the five sample medians per invocation; it is cumulative sample time, not a simultaneous page or peak.
method.selector_workload: Existing EPUB benchmark source unchanged; CSS fixtures replaced with 64 classes using valid ::selection, ::view-transition-old(...):only-child, and :host-context(.scope). Both versions accept the same CSS and produce the same matching outcomes in the synthetic non-shadow DOM.
method.unique_selector_workload: Same existing EPUB benchmark and fixtures as selector_workload, with 64 distinct :host-context(.scopeN) arguments per CSS file. Technical/visual fixtures combine two such files, so their arguments repeat across files. Both versions accept all CSS and produce equivalent synthetic matching outcomes.

repeat_method.frequency_control: Uncontrolled boost/governor; shared machine. Paired sampling reduces drift, but intervals do not model systematic host interference.
repeat_method.compiler: rustc opt-level=2 debuginfo=0, identical frozen native dependencies and support crates on both sides
repeat_method.previous_stage_candidate_workload_not_us: Existing EPUB benchmark source unchanged; CSS fixtures replaced with 64 classes using counter-reset, counter-increment, content:counter(), and :has(p). Forms valid and rendered equivalently in both builds.
repeat_method.ci_method: 5000 bootstrap resamples of paired percentage changes; deterministic seed 173, median, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; no multiple-comparison adjustment. Diagnostic evidence, not a universal performance claim.
repeat_method.previous_stage_fallback_workload_not_use: Same candidate CSS plus flex-basis:min-content and z-index:calc(3 - 2). Baseline ignores these declarations; the changed build applies them. This measures added feature cost, not equivalent-output regression.
repeat_method.combined_metric: all_samples sums the five sample medians per invocation; it is cumulative sample time, not a simultaneous page or peak.
repeat_method.selector_workload: Existing EPUB benchmark source unchanged; CSS fixtures replaced with 64 classes using valid ::selection, ::view-transition-old(...):only-child, and :host-context(.scope). Both versions accept the same CSS and produce the same matching outcomes in the synthetic non-shadow DOM.

interpretation: Positive percentage means slower. Intervals that include zero are inconclusive, not proof of equivalence.
Every timing/allocation/peak comparison is retained, including all positive changes. Intervals are diagnostic and not corrected for multiple comparisons.
Repeated-argument and unique-argument selectors are measured separately. A unique argument adds a native-token lookup/table cost; repeated arguments across CSS files can still reuse a result.
The table borrows argument token lists from existing fragments, stores booleans, allocates lazily and is dropped after preparing the rule set. No CSS strings or parsed selectors are retained.
No image suite was run. The selected syntax audit has exactly the same 2018 mismatch keys.
